text_block_list.text:
I go to the shopping district to buy some
things
on my day off, when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
So that's the Boutique Cherie's latest
dress?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Yes, our pride and joy! Isn't it nice? It's a

combination of python and leopard
prints! It even
has the faces of a snake
and a leopard on it!
text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper Lady

text_block_list.text:
Ummm... yeah, it's a bit flashy. I'll admit
it's got a
certain mature charm to it,
though.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Do you like it, Natie? I'll give you a
discount! I'll
even throw in a tiger print
pouch!
text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper Lady

text_block_list.text:
I don't think I'm ready for that
combination yet... I
mean, no one but
you can rock it.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Don't be like that, Natie! Anyone can
make it
work—you just have to put it on!
That's how
clothes work!
text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper Lady

text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Now that's the kind of pitch I
expect from
Boutique Cherie's
level-sixty-six saleswoman,
Kimie!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Ahaha, is that how old you think I am? Keep joking like that, and I'll force you to buy it.
text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper Lady

text_block_list.text: Hehe, please, don't!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Huh?! Тренер?!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
What are you doing here? Oh wait. It's
the
shopping district, so shopping, duh.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
That's right. You're the only young
person who
comes by here just to chat.
text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper Lady

text_block_list.text:
What do you mean? This shopping
district is the
hottest spot right now.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Look at this amazing selection too,
Trainer! This
place has the largest
selection of animal prints in
the world!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Oh, Kimie! Can you rustle up something
special
for my Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
And make it super intimidating! I don't
want
anyone messing with my trainer!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Come on, Natie. Don't tease your trainer
too
much.
text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper Lady

text_block_list.text:
Aren't you in the middle of shopping?
Why don't
you go too, Natie?
text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper Lady

text_block_list.text:
Nooo, I'm too tired. No way I could keep
up with
a youngster.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
You're too young for those kinds of
complaints!
Now stop loitering and go
enjoy your date!
text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper Lady

text_block_list.text: Okay, oka—huh?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: W-wait, no! It's not a date, okay?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
After that, Найс Нэйчер shows me around
the
shopping district, and I buy what I
came for.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Nnngh, we sure walked a lot! My back is
killing
me.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Nah, don't mention it. I didn't do
anything
special.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
All I did was chat with the shopping
district folks.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
But dang, they're clearly not busy
enough, seeing
as they all had time to
keep teasing me about
being on a date.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
While her words have an edge, Nice
Nature's
expression is kind when she
talks about the
people in the shopping
district.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I can tell that they all love her. And
beyond that,
I can tell they are people
she can rely on.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I-I do, but... why did you have to
actually say it?!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: It's kind of embarrassing...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: ...I guess so.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I mean, sure. They're probably nosier
than actual
parents.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
But all the same... they cheer for me no
matter
what.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Like, who would do that? Cheer for me?! It's funny, honestly.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: They care about me sooo much.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
And I get reeeeally motivated when they
cheer
me on.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
...Gyah, what am I saying?! How
embarrassing!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Three, two, one, and—gone! I just wiped
your
memory.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: All right, let's go home.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Найс Нэйчер is embarrassed and hurries
me back
to the academy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
